item.text: The sources confirm two key qualifications: matching comment retries return before checking the current snapshot hash, and diagram loading validates identity but leaves freshness comparison to callers. I’ll preserve those distinctions and condense routine implementation details.

{"ascii":"Reusable Agent Contexts: captured conversation + pinned evidence, reusable across sessions
|-- [M] AgentContext: validated value, independent of SDK and storage
|   |-- Public boundary: construct from trajectory/messages/snapshot; export or derive a new value
|   |   `-- [O] Private snapshot is cloned on entry and export; transformations leave it unchanged
|   |-- Validation protects a coherent conversation
|   |   |-- Trajectory slice follows one parent chain, then restores conversation order
|   |   |   `-- Missing links, cycles and duplicate entry IDs fail
|   |   |-- Assistant tool calls must have matching results before the next message or slice end
|   |   `-- Imported snapshots verify descriptor hash, format version and supplied attachments
|   `-- [D] Descriptor contentHash <- SHA-256(canonical descriptor)
|       |-- Inputs: version + source session identity + selected entry range + ordered messages
|       |-- Messages retain text, pinned references, named sections and tool exchanges
|       |-- Sorted object keys stabilize identity; array order and section boundaries matter
|       `-- Attached sourceFiles are excluded; their references inside messages are included
|-- [M] Evidence boundary: FileAgentContextSources implements capture/read/persist/portable
|   |-- Depends on registered source bindings, corpus reads, Git and ImmutableRecords
|   |   `-- Callers supply source ID + relative path + inclusive line bounds
|   |-- [C] capture -> choose a stable backing version -> validate range -> return reference
|   |   |-- Requested or binding-specified revision -> resolve commit -> read regular Git file
|   |   `-- Otherwise read current document
|   |       |-- Captured source-file hash matches HEAD -> retain Git commit reference
|   |       `-- Otherwise -> retain source-file snapshot in ImmutableRecords
|   |-- [D] Selected text <- pinned file + validated line bounds
|   |   |-- Git reference: registered repository + commit + path -> file
|   |   `-- Snapshot reference: source-file contentHash -> stored file value
|   |       `-- This hash identifies evidence content; it is distinct from descriptor contentHash
|   |-- persist(snapshot) -> store attachments -> verify references -> strip attachments
|   |   `-- Descriptor hash stays unchanged; evidence must be available before publication
|   `-- portable(snapshot) -> attach only selected lines -> rewrite references -> recompute hash
|       `-- [O] Adapter retains immutable evidence blobs; Git reads use a bounded, retryable cache
|-- [M] AgentContextLibrary: durable discovery and reuse, independent of canvas/chat identity
|   |-- Depends on AgentContext + saved-record contracts; I/O uses injected repository/source ports
|   |-- [C] create(explicit input, metadata, requestId) -> validate/capture -> persist -> save
|   |   |-- Accept text, ordered text/source constituents and sections, or an existing snapshot
|   |   |-- Source capture requires the source port; configured persistence verifies evidence
|   |   `-- Saved ID = saved-agent-context-<requestId>, addressable throughout the application store
|   |-- Retry identity is separate from content identity
|   |   |-- Same saved ID + matching requestHash -> return existing record; mismatch -> conflict
|   |   |-- Constituent creation checks its receipt before recapturing potentially changed sources
|   |   `-- Fork checks its receipt before rereading/checking the parent
|   |-- fork without a receipt -> require parent's expected descriptor hash -> new saved ID
|   |   `-- Copy snapshot, inherit/override metadata, record parent ID + hash; leave comments on parent
|   |-- Metadata operations preserve model-visible content and its descriptor hash
|   |   |-- Group can be assigned or cleared; it is separate from model-visible named sections
|   |   `-- addComment records text + timestamp + expected descriptor hash
|   |       |-- Existing comment request: matching text/hash -> replay; differing text/hash -> conflict
|   |       `-- New comment request: require current snapshot hash before appending
|   |-- Discovery: list returns filtered, paged summaries; lineage follows parent IDs root-to-selected
|   |   `-- Compare recorded parent hash with current parent's hash; missing/cyclic ancestry fails
|   `-- [O] FileAgentContextRepository owns durable records and private publication machinery
|       |-- Create: sync temporary record -> atomically publish without replacing an existing ID
|       |   `-- Read published record and compare requestHash, including concurrent creation
|       `-- Metadata: per-record cross-process lock -> read/modify -> atomic replacement
|           `-- Lock wait is bounded; finally blocks close handles and remove temporary files/held locks
|-- [C] Reuse handoff: library.read -> optional source expansion -> consumer's model conversion
|   |-- Read returns the saved snapshot/hash and, when expanded, a separate resolvedSnapshot
|   |-- AgentContext.resolveSources uses attached evidence first, otherwise the supplied reader
|   |   |-- Repeated identical references share a resolution promise within that operation
|   |   `-- Replace references with text, preserve sections, recompute descriptor hash
|   |       `-- Missing evidence or excessive expansion fails; saved content remains unchanged
|   `-- toPiMessages renders labeled section boundaries and rejects unresolved references
|       `-- Imported assistant provenance does not select a run's model; reading launches no model
`-- Diagram evidence binding: reuse AgentContext as captured background
    |-- [D] compileDiagramAgentContext(diagram)
    |   |-- Evidence originalLines + bounds -> attached source files + pinned range references
    |   |-- Binding + evidence metadata + references -> background user message -> AgentContext
    |   `-- sourceFingerprint <- SHA-256(JSON(binding + evidence)); retain compiledFromRevisionId
    |       `-- Fingerprint tracks captured evidence; revision records when compilation occurred
    |-- [O] Diagram carries one backing form
    |   |-- Inline snapshot supports compatibility and portable exports
    |   `-- store.put(snapshot) -> backingRecordId + descriptor contentHash + diagram/evidence identity
    `-- load -> inline snapshot or store.get(backingRecordId) -> validate snapshot and identity
        |-- Require matching descriptor hash when supplied, agentType and diagram ID
        |-- Freshness boundary: caller compares captured fingerprint with current evidence
        |   `-- Loading itself does not compare current evidence or require the current revision
        `-- Captured evidence supplies background; each later edit request supplies the current diagram"}
